releaseNotes:
• Official Release v1.1.0 (Build 11)
• Real-Time Private Chat: WhatsApp-style real-time messaging between Google accounts
• Real Voice Notes: Actual MediaRecorder capture, Firebase Storage upload & AudioPlayer streaming playback
• Real Gallery Photos: Android Photo Picker, auto-compression, storage upload & full-screen photo viewer
• Push Notifications: High-priority FCM background notifications for messages and calls
• Real WebRTC Voice & Video Calls: Live audio/video streaming with STUN NAT traversal
• Presence & Typing: Live online/offline status and real-time typing indicators
• Clean Production: All mock and demo content completely removed
